content: Official WordPress Plugin Handbook says classic admin plugin pages should use WordPress menu APIs, check the current user capability, wrap content in .wrap, validate/sanitize/escape input, and use core APIs such as Settings API for consistent registration, validation, capability protection, nonce integration, and admin notices. Existing GigPress already uses classic admin.php pages, a widefat shows table, filtering and pagination, wp_nonce_field, and options.php; refresh these patterns incrementally. WordPress accessibility guidance emphasizes labeled controls, actionable error identification, and table header semantics/scope. Confidence MEDIUM: official docs cross-checked with current repository structure; no visual audit.
